description: Merge 4x2: two independent sections, each merging up to four monophonic or polyphonic inputs into one polyphonic output

inputs.text: One of the signals merged into its section's output. Patch a section from the top down; a gap above the last patched port counts as one channel of 0V, and the lamp glows red when channels did not fit

outputs.text: The four inputs of the upper section merged into one polyphonic cable. Left unpatched, those four inputs are passed down to the lower output instead, so all eight can be merged into one cable
The four inputs of the lower section merged into one polyphonic cable, together with the upper four when the upper output is unpatched
